changes.text: The Where page calls only GET /api/where, with view=actions by default and view=stage when the stage view is selected, adding include_released=true and include_done=true when the released-and-done toggle is on, and never sending include_ended.

The page fetches on mount, every 60 seconds while mounted, on the Refresh button and immediately when the view or the toggle changes; a refetch keeps the previously rendered data visible and the loading state shows only while there is no data.
A failed fetch shows the error message with a Retry button while the last good data stays on screen, and a 401 goes through the existing API client so the app logs out.

Groups render in server order with the header <label> (<count>) as a level-2 heading, counting features or, for unassigned, workspaces; a group without features and without workspaces is not rendered, and when every group is empty the page shows Nothing to do.

A feature card shows the first 8 characters of its id, the title, the stage as a badge, the age of stage_set_at when set, a done or archived status badge, one #<number> <state> chip per pull request linking to its url in a new tab with rel noreferrer, and the line no worktrees when it has no workspaces.

A workspace row shows the machine, the branch or - when null, the path, git <age of git_state_at> or git ? when the snapshot is present, the risks in server order as dirty <n>, unpushed <n>, no upstream, interrupted and missing with the count omitted when unknown, and one session chip <agent_kind>/<status> <age> per session with dormant appended when dormant, or no sessions when there are none.

The rendered resume command is always the ssh form ssh -t <connect_target> <shell-quoted local command>, cds into resume_session.cwd when it equals or lies under the workspace path and else the path, uses the with_id template of the resume session agent kind whenever a resume session exists with the shell-quoted session id, else the without_id template of the resume session kind or the first session kind or claude-code, renders only the cd when that template is absent, and never applies a transcript-gone fallback.

Every workspace row shows its resume command as selectable text and a Copy resume command button that writes it with navigator.clipboard.writeText, reads Copied for two seconds after a success and Copy failed when the clipboard is missing or rejects.
Ages in the UI render as whole minutes under one hour, whole hours under 48 hours and whole days otherwise, the same formula as the CLI.

A Where tab sits between Tasks and Admin in the top bar, navigates to the where page, persists through the existing pgm_current_page key and renders WherePage with the existing API client, leaving every other page unchanged.
The Where page sends no write request: it never patches a workspace, never sets a stage and never attaches a pull request, so a read-scoped API key is enough.
